Trevor Lawrence and the Jacksonville Jaguars spent an extra few days off after a Thursday night win in Baltimore, and now the AFC's 6-2 contender heads to Nashville as a double-digit favorite. A path to the No. 1 seed runs through games like this one, against a 1-7 Tennessee Titans team that sold defensive starters at the deadline.
 Lawrence is playing the best football of his career. He's completed 65.2% of his passes for 1,932 yards with 18 touchdown passes and only four interceptions, according to ESPN , for a 111.7 passer rating. Here's what to expect Sunday.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Lawrence throws for 275 yards
 Oct 18, 2026; London, ENG; Jacksonville Jaguars quarterback Trevor Lawrence (16) throws the ball during the second half against the Houston Texans at Wembley Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Kirby Lee-Imagn Images
 Set that 8.6 yards per attempt next to a Titans defense allowing 258.3 passing yards per game, 31st in the league, and the matchup tilts hard toward Jacksonville. Lawrence averages 241.5 passing yards per game, and Tennessee traded Amani Hooker , who had five of its eight interceptions.
 Cornerback Joshua Williams allowed a 158.3 passer rating before the bye. Lawrence goes over his average with room to spare.
 Parker Washington catches a touchdown
 Nov 1, 2026; Jacksonville, Florida, USA; Jacksonville Jaguars wide receiver Parker Washington (11) runs with the ball during the first half against the Indianapolis Colts at EverBank Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Travis Register-Imagn Images
 Parker Washington leads the Jaguars with 29 catches on 55 targets for 493 yards and five touchdowns. With Jakobi Meyers dealing with an ankle injury , Washington becomes an even bigger part of the plan.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Brian Thomas Jr. has only 117 receiving yards, and he wasn't moved at the deadline . Washington is still the safer bet to find the end zone, and Lawrence finishes with at least two touchdown passes.
 A clean pocket all afternoon
 PFF gives the Titans the lowest team pass-rush grade in the league, and Jeffery Simmons, who had four of their 20 sacks, now plays in Chicago. Lawrence has been sacked only 13 times in eight games.
 Expect zero or one sack Sunday. A quarterback with a clean pocket and a 111.7 rating doesn't need much help against this defense.
